title: Final: LINQ
cards/0/task: The query is enumerated twice, and an extra OrderBy gets in the way. Make the source read at most 6 times and Where run at most 6 times.
cards/1/q: How many times does the query run?
cards/1/explain: Count, First and ToList each run the chain from scratch.
cards/2/q: What does OrderBy do when Take(1) follows it?
cards/2/options/0: Reads and sorts everything, then hands out one
cards/2/explain: For the minimum, Min() or MinBy() is better — one pass, no sorting.
cards/3/q: Which line pulls extra data from the database?
cards/3/explain: ToList loaded every customer into memory, so the filter and Take ran in C#.
cards/4/q: Which of these run the query? Select all.
cards/4/explain: OrderBy and Where only describe steps.
cards/5/q: Match the symptom to the cause
cards/6/q: Check for a match without scanning everything
cards/6/explain: Any with a condition stops at the first match.
cards/7/q: When is it worth rewriting LINQ as a loop?
cards/7/options/0: When the profiler shows a hot path with LINQ and its allocations
